modules.name: structured-logger.test.ts
key_scenarios: Log level filtering (debug, info, warn, error)

module_integration.initialization_pattern: All modules use singleton getters, initialized in coordinator run()

feedback.issue: Console output volume (100+ console.log/console.error statements) vs invested structured-logger module
feedback.suggestion: Gradually migrate console statements to logger.info/logger.error calls to leverage JSON structured logging. This improves log aggregation in production systems (DataDog, Splunk, CloudWatch). Can be incremental across iterations.
feedback.impact: Production observability and log parsing efficiency

feedback.issue: Metrics collector module initialized but not actively recording task data during execution
feedback.suggestion: Add metricsCollector.recordTaskCompletion() calls during/after task execution to track completion rates, average durations, and failure patterns. Example: metricsCollector.recordTaskCompletion({ taskId, status: 'completed', durationMs, tier }). This activates the 39 tests worth of collector functionality.
feedback.impact: Production observability metrics not being captured

feedback.issue: API key sanitization patterns are comprehensive but could anticipate future expansions
feedback.suggestion: Current patterns cover tr_*, sk-*, Bearer, api_key, token. Consider adding claude_key, anthropic_api_key patterns proactively for future provider integrations. Current coverage meets all immediate use cases.
